● The list-filter pass is substantially complete. Here's the final picture.

  Result

  Branch feature/list-filters — 10 commits, 92 files, +1,380 / −2,341 (net −961 lines). Every commit passed the pre-commit gate (backend lint, frontend lint, type-check), and the final tree passes a clean build.

  Bugs fixed
  - ~48 white/var(--bg)-on-var(--accent) → var(--text-on-accent) (invisible/low-contrast in dark mode). 0 residual.
  - ~180 wrong/redundant var(--x, #hex) fallbacks dropped — some were genuinely wrong (a dark value used as a light fallback). 0 residual.
  - Added the previously-undefined --info* and semantic --*-text tokens to all three palettes (light/dark/colorblind) — a latent bug in Dashboard's info/warning banners.

  Componentization (new themed primitives, colours 100% from CSS vars, real :hover/:active/:disabled)
  - <FilterBar> (+ .bar classes) adopted in 35 files; .chip in 26; <EmptyState> in 16; <LoadingState> in 15. Dozens of dead style-consts deleted — hence the large net deletion.

  Mobile
  - Grid min() overflow guards; ReportsTable horizontal scroll; toolbar flexWrap across migrated screens. Confirmed DataTable/NoteBoard/Modal were already responsive.

  Intentionally left inline (the abstraction doesn't fit): segmented/tab controls, chips, steppers, icon buttons, calendar cells, dense in-table actions, and buttons on --purple/--warning/--success backgrounds (no variant). Forcing these would reduce quality.

  Deferred (documented in docs/plans/plan-filters.md): Modal consolidation — 34 custom overlays → a shared portal/Modal. It needs real decisions (z-index hierarchy, mobile bottom-sheet, focus/backdrop), so it's its own effort, not mechanical.

  Process notes: one parallel subagent ran a git reset that wiped peers' uncommitted work; I caught it via reflog, recovered, then forbade git in all subsequent agents and committed between waves. I've saved that learning to memory. The one verification I can't do from here is live visual QA
  in dark + colorblind themes — the changes are CSS-variable swaps with strong static guarantees (every token defined in all 3 palettes, build green), but a human eye in the actual themes is the real proof. I can launch the app and walk a few screens if you want.
